ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 60% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity (black) region widening toward the notch; high-intensity (white) fields on lateral lobes containing numerous low-intensity linear and cluster-type pixel disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth is 15% of total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 2 to 12 pixels, particularly concentrated on the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep on the upper trailing edges toward the tips; convex sweep on the lower edges leading from the peduncle base.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark, roughly circular pixel anomalies detected at the trailing edge tips and along the mid-right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) breaking the white pigmentation; visible parallel orientation on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both ventral lobes; jagged, non-uniform trailing edge topography suggests cumulative physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific dark pigmentation patterns on the right lobe resembling individual character strokes or symbols.
